script.title: GETTING A MOVING QUOTE
script.story_hook: Comparing prices for a cross-town move with a piano.
script.intro_zh: 帶著鋼琴搬去城另一頭，先問清楚費用。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today we're getting a moving quote, piano and all.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎大家回來！今天我們來問搬家的報價，連鋼琴也算在內。
script.outro: That's all we have today! One more listen and it's yours. Bye for now!
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！再聽一遍就會了。先說再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Ready to practice? Say every line right after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 準備好練習了嗎？每一句都跟著我馬上說一遍。
script.char_a_description: a neat elderly East Asian man in his mid-sixties with thinning white hair combed to the side, a beige cardigan over a checked flannel shirt, holding old reading glasses and a small notebook full of moving questions
script.char_b_description: a tall, muscular Latino man in his late twenties with short black hair shaved on the sides, a bright orange safety vest over a grey tee, work gloves tucked in his back pocket, lightly bouncing on his toes
script.youtube_title: 【🚚💸搬家報價】「鋼琴要另加錢？」樓梯費、紙箱全問清楚，聽完就會預約｜📦Moving Quote English
script.youtube_title_en: “Do You Provide Boxes?” — Getting a Moving Quote Without Surprises
script.youtube_description:
搬家報價聽得懂開頭，卻永遠聽不到最後的隱藏費用？這段搬家公司現場對話一次幫你問到底！從鋼琴加價、四樓無電梯的樓梯費，到免費紙箱與白紙黑字的總額。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Moving quotes always seem to hide the best parts, right? This on-the-spot conversation with a moving crew asks it all: the piano surcharge, a stair fee for a broken elevator, free boxes, and a written total — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and book your move with confidence.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚚搬家報價英文｜鋼琴加價・樓梯費用・免費紙箱｜聽完就會問清楚｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
搬家報價總是有聽沒有懂的追加項目？
鋼琴、樓梯、紙箱，用英文要怎麼一項一項問？

這一集帶大家走進搬家公司的門市，跟著屋主從報告坪數與搬家日期，到確認鋼琴加價、四樓無電梯的樓梯費，再到免費紙箱與書面總額，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📅 日期與屋況：例如「When's the big day?」、「Two bedrooms, and there's a piano.」。
🎹 加價項目：例如「The piano adds a hundred and fifty.」、「There's a stair charge, twenty-five more.」。
📦 紙箱與書面報價：例如「Do you provide boxes?」、「Could you send the total in writing?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完這一集，搬家前先問價，錢包會感謝你！
script.thumbnail_action: writing numbers in a small notebook across from a mover

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like a quote for moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk ə kwoʊt fɚ ˈmuˌvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想請你們報一個搬家的價格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to help. When's the big day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə hɛlp wɛnz ðə bɪɡ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很樂意。哪天是搬家大日子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The twelfth of next month, hopefully.
dialogue.zh: 下個月的十二號，希望來得及。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. How big is the place?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bedrooms, and there's a piano.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbɛdˌru mz ænd ðɛrz ə piˈænoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 兩間臥室，而且還有一台鋼琴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, the piano adds a hundred and fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðə piˈænoʊ ædz ə ˈhʌndrəd ænd ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 啊，鋼琴要另外加一百五十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 噢。這個真的非加不可嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's special straps and two extra guys.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈspɛʃəl stræps ænd tu ˈɛkstrə ɡaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那要用專用綁帶，還要多兩位人手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好吧，這樣聽起來還算合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does either place have stairs to worry about?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ˈiːðər pleɪs hæv stɛrz tə ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 兩邊住家有沒有要擔心的樓梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes — fourth floor, and the elevator's broken.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɔrθ flɔr ænd ðə ˈɛləˌveɪtərz ˈbroʊkən/
dialogue.zh: 有——四樓，而且電梯壞掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then there's a stair charge, twenty-five more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɛrz ə stɛr tʃɑrdʒ ˈtwɛnti faɪv mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那會有一筆樓梯費，再加二十五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we do anything about that one?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi du ˈɛniˌθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這個有機會想辦法減一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just pack light boxes; we'll carry more.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pæk laɪt bɑksəz wil ˈkæri mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 只要箱子裝輕一點，我們一趟就能多搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fair enough. Do you provide boxes?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛr ɪˈnʌf du ju prəˈvaɪd bɑksəz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，好說。你們會提供紙箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty free boxes, plus tape on us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti fri ˈbɑksəz plʌs teɪp ɑn ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 二十個免費紙箱，膠帶也算我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Could you send the total in writing?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs kʊd ju sɛnd ðə ˈtoʊtəl ɪn ˈrɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好。可以請你把總金額白紙黑字傳給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already on its way to your email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn ɪts weɪ tə jɔr ˈiˌmeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 已經在寄到你信箱的路上了。
